problems.symptom: Commits and shell calls made on behalf of a dispatch carry execution_id=null. They are untraced, and the mint deferral cannot match them.
problems.root_cause: Every resolver hop that rebuilds a pointer from an allow-list drops context fields. The id was stamped per hop instead of carried as shared context.

problems.symptom: The live runtime tree holds uncommitted or rolled-back drafts. Pre-snapshots see the change, created files are orphaned, a vessel restarts onto a duplicate insert, and the harness is fooled.
problems.root_cause: feature_compose preLiveSync stages drafts into /vessels before the cutover. Rollback covers isolated vessels only and does not remove created files.

problems.symptom: Verified FAVORABLE drafts are discarded or parked because the global change_window lease is held.
problems.root_cause: trace-store-reconcile crystallized with a redacted token and a stale TTL. It fails every run before releasing the single global lease.

problems.symptom: local-tools' discovery row points at an ephemeral port, and compose grounding windows are 0 bytes.
problems.root_cause: Transient verify instances register under the live vessel id. The real vessel registers only at boot, so the row never heals.

problems.symptom: Verification and validation code writes to live stores: a phantom gap in live gaps.json, the live canary overwritten, real git commits from probes, placeholder-filled gaps.
problems.root_cause: Verify instances, author_producer validateProducesShape and draft execution run against live stores and the real producers without a sandbox. The probe restore path mapped the wrong root.

problems.symptom: Landings pass every gate but do nothing: a reader with no writer, dead string keys, a copied node_modules consumer.
problems.root_cause: The gates read a diff and never execute the main path. There is no per-resolver test requirement.

problems.symptom: The ledger settles 'held' on the commit that stopped every landing (0a0d59f), blames unrelated landings for restart flips, and readiness passes a dead container.
problems.root_cause: The check set observes liveness and gate refusals, not a positive 'known-good landing still lands' case. There is no restart discriminator, and silent skips count as passes.

problems.symptom: Reach is graded wrong: a landed edit is graded reached:false (#12), an old commit of the same goal text gives false credit (#37), and one goal produces many commits (#46).
problems.root_cause: The edit-intent route falls through to the walk and grades the walk. The gap id is a hash of the goal text. Retries are not idempotent over side effects.

problems.symptom: One edit dispatch is routed to feature_compose twice. A second compose lands inside the next run's window.
problems.root_cause: The post-walk EDIT-INTENT route does not check whether this dispatch's edit already landed or is in flight. The 4dec1bc guard covers only escalation.

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings inside graded windows break routing or landing (8c31cdb fetch patch; 0a0d59f drift deadlock; 91c042b changed U's path).
problems.root_cause: Window-blind dispatchers: landing, restart and sync paths read no shared window/lease shape. Gates do not check for process-global side effects.

problems.symptom: self-recovery restarts saturated vessels and kills in-flight composes. pull-sync takes owed restarts on content that already matches. Breadcrumbs misattribute restarts.
problems.root_cause: The liveness probe cannot tell saturation from death, db_pressure_backoff reads 0, restarters read no window shape, and breadcrumbs are not PID-bound.

problems.symptom: Trace-ingest storm: 1064 POSTs and 1194 duplicate-id errors per 5 min, 233 POSTs of 60 s or more, host load around 30. A quadratic ledger scan blocks the event loop.
problems.root_cause: Clients re-send slow trace POSTs while the first insert is still in flight. The FTS REBUILD averages 833 s. The onset trigger was never identified.

problems.symptom: sed -i fall-through appended one line 658,893 times (170 MB goal-host index.ts) plus 3 other files, with no commit, invisible to hooks and the ledger.
problems.root_cause: The walk tool fallback on edit goals is ungated, and the satisfier's fs-write refusal does not cover shell. Operator dispatches without the operator body field competed as autonomous, were refused BUSY, and were retried.

problems.symptom: Seed and learned templates drift from source (TTL, redacted placeholders). bootstrap-seeder refuses 19 templates.
problems.root_cause: The seeder skips a populated catalogue. Extraction redacts placeholders. The learning_track field is required but unset.

problems.symptom: The drafter needs an operator-added region hint. Drafts come from weak models, and anchors come from a stale window.
problems.root_cause: Hardcoded OpenRouter model list and claude-slug routing. The window is built from the stale super-repo copy. Constraints such as 'python/node absent' are not read at use time.

problems.symptom: The drafter-facing consequence lesson is dropped. A parked verdict is reported as UNFAVORABLE. Intent touched_files misses swept-in files.
problems.root_cause: writeLesson guards on a gap that was never persisted; goal-host drops the parked flag; the intent is registered from the plan, not the diff.

problems.symptom: The LLM plane ran dry (402 from OpenRouter and Chutes), llm_completion was de-advertised, and no gap was filed.
problems.root_cause: There is no detector for provider credit exhaustion.

problems.symptom: substrate-live was removed by a concurrent session (docker rm -f) and was down about 2 h. Nothing observed its absence.
problems.root_cause: Shared live container with no lease; observers run inside the thing that disappeared.

problems.symptom: CLAUDE.md's one-file-per-goal guidance contradicts the semantic judge, which requires a new resolver's registration in the same compose.
problems.root_cause: The doc rule predates the semantic judge's 'no callers' rejection.

principles: A new resolver must not land without a per-resolver test that executes its main path; gates that read a diff cannot see dead string keys (GAPS_OBSERVED #22)
A file present in /vessels is not landing evidence; read the push clone's HEAD (#23, #38)

A context field threaded through a resolver chain is lost at every hop that rebuilds its pointer from an allow-list, so trace the full chain through discovery before dispatching per-hop fixes (#43 addendum)
Instrument rather than infer: after reasoning refuted candidate hops, logging at the receiver named the caller (RUN10-FAIL-1600)
The baseline check set must include a positive 'known-good landing still lands' (landing_liveness) case, or the worst regression, of the landing path itself, is invisible (#47)
A flip coinciding with an unreachable dependency or a recorded restart settles unresolved, not regressed: surprise, not blame (#36, design D7)
Register attempt intent from the commit diff, not the compose plan, and flag surplus files (#44)
Validation probes must run in a sandbox or be refused for side-effecting commands (#60)
A retry must be idempotent over its side effects (#46)
One shared window/lease shape should be read by the landing, restart and sync paths; windows announced to sessions have no reader in the substrate (#56, #59)
Tell saturation from death before restarting, and back off under DB pressure (#55)
One field, one meaning: two checks reading staged_base_sha with two meanings deadlocked or broke landings (#51)
Record refuted hypotheses so they are not re-tried, and mark relayed claims as not measured (RUN0, #47, #54 corrections)
Do not change a grader after the fact; a void run counts as no pass (RUN12, RUN10-VOID-0715, RUN11-VOID-1220)
Operator identity must travel in the dispatch body, not only as a tag; otherwise operator work competes as autonomous work and cascades into retries (#35)
A silent skip reads as a pass (#30)
The routable model set should come from the provider's live list, not a literal (#17)
A crystallized template can freeze a defect (redacted placeholder, stale TTL); seed and learned templates need drift detection against source (#14, #18)
